name: BWild Grain Free Sterilised Tuna with Peas
label: 1.5 kg

lifestage.quote: a complete and balanced pet food for adult sterilised cats

special-diet.quote: Formulated for the wellbeing of your sterilised cat

health-feature.quote: It contains taurine to support the cardiac functions

texts.about_this_item: Monge BWild Grain Free Formula Sterilised Cat Tuna with Peas is a complete and balanced food for adult sterilised cats, formulated with L-Carnitine and DL-Methionine to help ideal body weight control. Uses alternative carbohydrate sources (peas) and high quality ingredients such as tuna. Enriched with MOS and XOS prebiotics, omega-3 fatty acids for coat shine, and taurine for cardiac function. No added dyes or artificial preservatives.
texts.ingredient_information: Tuna (dried 38%, fresh 15%), potatoes (15%), animal fat (10%) (chicken oil purified 99.5%), potato protein, dried beet pulp, peas (5%), pea fibre, hydrolysed animal proteins, dried fish salmon (4%), minerals, fish oil (salmon oil purified at 99.5%), mannan-oligosaccharides (MOS 1%), spiruline (0.6%), xylo-oligosaccharide (XOS 0.3%), yucca schidigera (0.1%), milk protein powder.
texts.feeding_instructions: Recommended daily feeding intakes may be split into 2 daily meals. Individual nutritional requirements may vary due to size, age and living conditions of the animal. Fresh and clean water should be available at all times.
